packageRules.description: kube-prometheus upstream asks consumers to follow the release-* branches; the vX.Y.Z tags only exist to notify users about a new release. Disable the native jsonnet-bundler (git-tags) handling for this single dependency so the custom regex manager below can track the branch instead.

customManagers.description: Track the kube-prometheus jsonnet-bundler dependency against the release-* branch (e.g. release-0.18, release-0.19, ...) rather than its release tags.
